en.topic_title: Hong Kong 2019 protest prosecutions ‘no barrier’ to BN(O) visa route, UK home secretary confirms
en.topic_summary:
Britain’s home secretary has confirmed that prosecutions for taking part in the 2019 pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong will not prevent otherwise eligible applicants from accessing the British National (Overseas) visa route.



The UK Houses of Parliament, Westminster, London. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP.
